ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage across the central ventral surface, with 15% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on the peripheral trailing edges and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central field. The lateral tips exhibit high-contrast black borders; specifically, the right tip contains a geometric, lattice-like black pattern, while the left tip shows a solid black terminal edge with internal white mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 45-degree angle and a bounding-box depth equivalent to ~12% of the total vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable high-amplitude peaks and valleys (notches) are present on the medial-to-lateral portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convex sweep along the trailing edges; the leading edge presents a relatively linear trajectory with a slight terminal convexity toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12 circular, low-contrast indentations (depressions) clustered primarily in the upper-central and left-central white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-right lobe, extending approximately 10% of the lobe's height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged indentation/notch located on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ladder-step' pigmentation pattern localized on the far right lateral tip, characterized by alternating black and white rectangular pixel clusters.
